cited.quote: amended so as to grant one day weekly off to all Police personnel up to the rank of Head Constable
to give one day weekly-off to all the Police Personnel working in Tamil Nadu Special Police Battalions

rationale: C4 records that G.O. 469 (dated 03.11.2021) amended the Police Standing Orders to give one day weekly off to police up to Head Constable, and its own G.O. 416 extends the weekly off to all personnel in Special Police Battalions. Scope matches the promise, though ranks above Head Constable are not shown.

cited.quote: this Government has been urging the Government of India to provide reservation to all the Backward Classes

rationale: C1 and C3 only state in general terms that the Government has been urging the Union Government on OBC reservation. No Assembly resolution, Chief Minister's letter or GO on the Mandal Commission recommendations is shown, and the statements carry no date of a formal step.

cited.quote: instruments of release involving transfer of properties in favour of family members attract stamp duty

rationale: C1 and C3 are audit reports describing the existing concessional stamp duty and registration fee on family transfers, which predate this government. C5 reduces registration fee only for women purchasers of sale deeds, a different group and action. No reduction for transfers between blood relatives is shown.

cited.quote: Conferment of powers to the X Additional City Civil Court for exclusive trial of cases under Prevention of Corruption Act 1988

rationale: C4 is a GO dated 09.03.2023 designating the X Additional City Civil Court at Chennai for exclusive trial of Prevention of Corruption Act cases. This is a real step on special courts for corruption cases, but it is a single court in Chennai and mainly a workload arrangement. C1 special courts date from 2011-14, before this government.

cited.quote: Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly proceedings are complied and sent as video Clippings to government and private TV Channels

rationale: C1 says Assembly proceedings are compiled and sent as video clippings to TV channels, which is not a live telecast. No extract shows a GO, order or launch of live telecast of the Assembly.

C1 and C5 are pension policy notes about Contributory Pension Scheme subscriber numbers, and C2-C4 are ad hoc bonus GOs. None concerns counting 50% part-time service of ad hoc employees made permanent in school education for pension.

C1-C3 are HR&CE policy notes on staff, welfare and temple development, C4 is a tourism GO and C5 is a general senior citizens policy for old age homes. None mentions a separate darshan queue for senior citizens in HR&CE temples.

cited.quote: providing subsidy of Rs.1,00,000/- each to 500 registered unorganised women drivers

rationale: C4 gives an auto purchase subsidy of Rs.1,00,000 to registered unorganised women and transgender drivers through the Welfare Board, a different amount and beneficiary group from Rs.10,000 for town and corporation drivers with TIIC or bank loans. C1-C3 and C5 are general MSME subsidies. No matching step.

cited.quote: Water quality shall be tested through the distributed Field Test Kits in the village panchayats

rationale: C3 is a Jal Jeevan Mission operation and maintenance policy and C5 describes existing village water supply; C1 concerns town panchayats. None shows an order for replacing old or damaged pipes in all villages. C2 and C4 are school repair schemes.

C1 and C3 list breastfeeding support among free maternal services in health facilities, C2 covers diet and antenatal care, C4 is a cleanliness campaign GO and C5 is labour toilet rules. None concerns nursing stations with privacy in public places.

cited.quote: provide hygienic food to slum dwellers, daily wage labourers, unemployed youth and downtrodden people at subsidised prices

rationale: C2 is an audit of the earlier Amma Canteens. C4 allows millet canteens in hospitals run by self-help groups, which is a different scheme. No extract shows Kalaignar Canteens or any GO to open 500 subsidised canteens.

cited.quote: One Kg. of Tur Dal and one litre of Palmolein Oil pouch is distributed at the rate of Rs.30/-

rationale: C3 shows Palmolein oil in one litre pouches and tur dal already distributed under the Special PDS scheme running since 2007. This is the same activity continuing, with no new GO, programme or step to pack sugar, maida, dals and oil. C1 and C5 only assign subjects to officers.

cited.quote: produced through Weavers Co-operative Societies and supplied to the Revenue Department for distributing it to the beneficiaries

rationale: C1 and C4 show the sarees and dhoties scheme, running since 1983, with production through weaver cooperatives, mostly powerloom. No new order or preferential contract scheme for handloom weavers is shown. C4 notes a pre-loom wage increase from 01.11.2021, which is not an award of contracts.

cited.quote: Inclusion of traditional industries under thrust sector for availing Special Capital Subsidy
lock and silk based industries may be categorised as

rationale: C5 is a GO dated 2021-10-22 bringing lock manufacturing and silk based industries under thrust sector Special Capital Subsidy. That covers two of the named sectors. No extract shows a scheme for fireworks, mixers or grinders; C4 fireworks items are safety and insurance. Hence partial.

cited.quote: To provide assistance under Q-CERT scheme for enterprises which are new to exports of value added coir products

rationale: C5 is a GO of 2025-06-27 earmarking Q-CERT and capital subsidy funds for enterprises new to exports of value added coir products. It is a narrow export assistance step for one sector under existing schemes, not a general package for MSME clusters. C1-C4 do not show an export package.

C1 is an ethanol blending policy, C2 and C3 a pumped storage policy, C4 a policy note on existing power purchase agreements and C5 tourism PPP projects. None concerns purchasing power from agricultural biomass fuel producers under a PPP scheme.

cited.quote: The Government have accorded administrative sanction for acquisition of 535.10 acres of patta land
About 601.20 acres of patta lands have been acquired and handed over to the AAI.
Also, 148.28 acre land is being acquired at a cost of Rs.350 crore for the expansion of Salem airport.

rationale: C1 reports administrative sanction for land acquisition at Salem and Thoothukudi. C2 reports about 601 acres acquired and handed to AAI for Thoothukudi, and C3 reports more Salem land being acquired. Expansion is done by AAI and no extract shows it operational, so this is in progress.

cited.quote: Crop insurance provides financial support to farmers affected by crop loss or damage due to unforeseen natural calamities.

rationale: C2 and C5 describe crop insurance covering natural calamities only. C1, C3 and C4 concern the Forest Department compensation scheme for wildlife damage, in force since 2016 and only funded again. No order extends the crop insurance scheme to wildlife damage.

cited.quote: every case / proposal of compensation for loss of crops/damage to property by wild animals has to be scrutinized properly

rationale: C3 and C5 are funding sanctions for the existing wildlife compensation scheme, with an internal scrutiny instruction to the forest officials; the scheme is based on a 2016 GO. The same activity continues, and no guidelines for farmers to claim compensation are shown.

cited.quote: conversion of over head line (OH) to underground cable (UG) have been taken up in the Chennai city and extended areas

rationale: C4 shows overhead to underground conversion under way in five Chennai divisions at Rs. 993.32 crore. C2 reports tenders floated for remaining divisions and a temple streets contract. This covers Chennai and a few sites rather than all cities, is not shown operational, and no dated GO is given.
